title: fix(ai): capture an error event when a streaming call fails to connect

files.patch:
@@ -0,0 +1,5 @@
+---
+pypi/posthog: patch
+---
+
+Capture an `$ai_generation` error event when `create(stream=True)` fails before the stream starts (bad key, rate limit, invalid model) in the OpenAI chat, OpenAI Responses, Anthropic and Gemini wrappers, sync and async. Previously only errors raised mid-stream were captured.

+class _ConnectError(RuntimeError):
+    status_code = 401
+

+def test_openai_chat_stream_connect_error(mock_client):
+    from posthog.ai.openai import OpenAI
+
+    with patch("openai.resources.chat.completions.Completions.create") as create:
+        create.side_effect = _ConnectError("bad key")
+        client = OpenAI(api_key="k", posthog_client=mock_client)
+        with pytest.raises(_ConnectError):
+            client.chat.completions.create(
+                model="gpt-4",
+                messages=[{"role": "user", "content": "hi"}],
+                stream=True,
+            )
+
+    props = _props(mock_client)
+    assert props["$ai_is_error"] is True
+    assert props["$ai_http_status"] == 401
+
+
